proposed_from.topic: Boundary-honest SCM partial identification and inference for environment-specific direct effects from an LDiffPC equality/sepset ledger. For two positive diff-faithful linear-Gaussian acyclic SCMs with baseline-parent modular interventions, invariant innovation variances, and a common order, define the exact compatible-completion effect fiber Ψ(s); prove its finite semialgebraic branch representation and exact finite-sample coverage of the fixed direct-effect triple by projecting a paired Wishart covariance region through Ψ. Derive Fell boundary random-set limits using tangent-cone regularity and derived rational-branch smoothness, an exact p=3 collider singleton audit, and every-p≥3 same-law noncontraction and infinite global worst-case expected-diameter converses, with converse-only transfer to the full Bystrova–Devijver anchor class and finite attainment of each bounded Gaussian tangent minimax problem. On a separately declared coefficient/covariance-bounded Gaussian subclass, establish exact projected-Wishart coverage and explicit finite-sample constant-factor minimax expected-diameter bounds without separation or beta-min assumptions. Make no componentwise uniform-single-door iff, fixed-treewidth algorithm, rejection-certificate, non-Gaussian exact positive-inference, or exact minimax-optimality claim.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: Generic test inversion, unioning over uncertain causal structures, and explicit confidence construction are prior art: StriederDrton2024DualLikelihood Theorem 2 gives an asymptotic union of intervals for one scalar total effect under unknown single-environment equal-error-variance Gaussian DAG structure, StriederDrton2023Confidence provides related structure-and-effect confidence procedures, and WangKolarDrton2023ConfidenceSets uses residual-bootstrap goodness-of-fit tests in identifiable additive-error structural equation models to form asymptotic causal-order confidence sets and post-processed model-uncertainty effect intervals. ChangGuoMalinsky2026PostSelection Theorem 2 covers a fixed effect asymptotically after ordinary PC discovery, while its Theorem 3 reaches oracle equality only under a strong nonzero-association lower bound and its discussion leaves minimal width inflation unresolved. GuoWuYiu2026Price conditions on the Gaussian-FCI selection event and, with known variance and its Markov-blanket condition, covers the selected adjustment functional exactly. The distinct contribution is the exact paired unrestricted-covariance Wishart pivot projected through a finite two-environment LDiffPC equality/sepset direct-effect multifunction, yielding unconditional finite-sample coverage for a fixed three-coordinate target without a known ledger, beta-min margin, or unique branch. The boundary theorem derives the jointly local branch-cone random-closed-set law under simultaneous \(N^{-1/2}\)-local regression-equality, conditional-independence, and completion boundaries. The same-observed-law theorem adds a diameter lower bound that distinguishes necessary noncontraction from conservatism.

seed_details.one_line: Componentwise generic direct-effect identification iff the LDiffPC ledger forces zero or admits a completion-uniform single-door set.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Lift the fully specified difference-graph theorem to irreducible components of the partial covariance-pair and equality-ledger model.
seed_details.anchor_read: Read the introduction, Theorem 1 and appendix proof, and conclusion of BystrovaDevijver2026LDiffPC; Theorem 3, Lemmas 4--6, proof construction, discussion, and conclusion of Assaad2025DifferenceGraphs; Proposition 2 and Sections 2, 4, and 5 of GarciaPuenteSpielvogelSullivant2010ComputerAlgebra; and the predecessor-regression, smoothness, saturation, and discussion sections of BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026ColoredDAG.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate from Assaad2025DifferenceGraphs because its common-single-door theorem already gives the iff criterion.
seed_details.rebuttal: Assaad fixes a complete difference graph, whereas an LDiffPC ledger leaves multiple covariance-compatible orders and adds algebraic equalities that may make competing regressions coincide on individual irreducible components; proving that no such extra generic identification occurs is precisely the unresolved necessity step.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The kernel is not a graph-only MPDAG restatement: it requires radical nonmembership or same-component countermodels for every rejected partial-ledger component.
seed_details.burned_reason: Angle 0's claimed exhaustive p=4 certificate contained only one explicit row and one intensional protocol record, so the angle was retired without supporting its universal necessity theorem.

seed_details.one_line: Exact radical-membership certificates with positive same-component SCM countermodel families on rejection.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Replace numerical feasibility by a terminating algebraic decision procedure for paired invariant-noise ledger components.
seed_details.anchor_read: Read the target-augmented elimination criterion and exhaustive small-graph study in GarciaPuenteSpielvogelSullivant2010ComputerAlgebra, together with the rational inverse and saturation construction in BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026ColoredDAG.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is only a routine application of Gröbner bases to a larger polynomial model.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nonroutine content is the positive-real component discipline and compilation of radical nonmembership into two common-order, invariant-noise SCM families sharing the same covariance pair and complete ledger.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed does not treat CAD partitioning as causal completeness; the structural family certificate is mandatory.
seed_details.status: survived and incorporated as the certificate theorem

seed_details.one_line: Boundary-honest confidence unions for the two-environment direct-effect triple after equality-ledger discovery.
seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Cover the causal target uniformly when equality, conditional-independence, and competing-regression margins approach zero jointly.
seed_details.anchor_read: Read Sections 3--4 and the discussion of StriederDrton2023Confidence, including its composite test inversion, and Theorems 1--3, screening construction, proofs, and discussion of ChangGuoMalinsky2026PostSelection.
seed_details.referee_objection: A union over candidate graphs is already supplied by ChangGuoMalinsky2026PostSelection.
seed_details.rebuttal: That result treats ordinary CI-selected graphs and a fixed effect; the proposed random closed set ranges over two covariance laws, equality-ledger changes, irreducible components, and all three coordinates of a direct-effect contrast, with exact covariance inversion at the boundaries.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The inference rung is attached to the componentwise identification shape and is not labeled as a standalone M8 seed.
seed_details.status: survived and incorporated as the inference theorem

proposed_from.literature_map: [Bystrova and Devijver (2026)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13947) introduce diff-separation and LDiffPC; Theorem 1 recovers the difference skeleton and sound orientations but supplies no effect-query frontier. [Assaad (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.01292) is the closest effect comparator: Theorem 3 gives the zero-or-common-single-door iff criterion for a fully specified difference graph and names the ovarian-cancer BIRC3-to-PRKAR2B use. [Garcia-Puente, Spielvogel, and Sullivant (2010)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1007.3784) provide target-augmented elimination tests and small-graph generic-identification audits, but not paired equality-ledger components. [Boege, Kubjas, Misra, and Solus (2026)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.04024) provide predecessor-regression recovery, smooth colored-DAG geometry, and vanishing-ideal saturation. [Foygel, Draisma, and Drton (2012)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1107.5552) show how graphical identification certificates can support polynomial algorithms while leaving an explicit completeness gap. [Perkovic (2020)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.02997) settles graph-only effect identification for ordinary MPDAGs, so cross-environment ledger equations must be load-bearing here. [Strieder and Drton (2023)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.04298) invert structure-and-effect tests for a single-environment total effect. [Chang, Guo, and Malinsky (2026)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.06763) screen resampled PC graphs and union graph-specific intervals, but do not handle paired regression-equality ledgers. [Wu and Drton (2023)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08959) characterize partial-homoscedastic equivalence classes and delimit the separate block-invariance extension. No closer paper found in these threads subsumes the componentwise uniform-single-door necessity kernel.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The random-set limits require tangent-cone regularity at the specified boundary point; branch smoothness is derived from rational predecessor-regression formulas and positive-definite principal-minor denominators.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The Fell and Hausdorff limits require ass:tangent-cone-regularity; branch smoothness is supplied by lem:branch-target-rational-smooth-extension rather than assumed.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The decision problem is restricted to a singleton zeroth-order target and a fixed bounded tangent radius R.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any attainment or finite-sample-pullback result is conditional on Gamma(s0)={tau0} and the bounded branch-labelled experiment Lambda_R.

banked_reason: Substrate unbuildable: field-tier mathematics passed discovery, but faithful axiom-free Lean formalization requires missing real-semialgebraic foundations and a local LDiffPC soundness development.
